Mr. Peppin proceeded to place the two suitcases into the bed of the truck and then got into the back seat
police seized three (3) kilograms of cocaine and 44 pounds of cannabis marihuana from the two suitcases possessed by John Peppin
John Peppin acknowledges that he trafficked three (3) kilograms of cocaine and 44 pounds of cannabis marihuana on November 16, 2017
rationale_highlights: The ISR identifies seven systemic background factors that are applicable to Mr. Peppin
The evidence before me supports a conclusion that Mr. Peppin has been affected by poor social and economic conditions
I find that Mr. Peppin's unique background factors played a part in bringing Mr. Peppin before the court in this case and therefore mitigate his moral culpability
I have found that Mr. Peppin's Indigenous social context factors, which informed his pathway to offending, must be considered in assessing his moral blameworthiness

crime_highlights: Mr. Omar appeared, ascended the stairs, and stabbed Mr. Aro with a knife in the elbow, causing significant bleeding
Approximately two minutes later, Mr. Omar attempted to break into Mr. Aro's bedroom
Mr. Omar then raised the knife above his head and struck Mr. Aro in the head with the sharp side of the knife in a chopping motion
This caused two significant lacerations on the side of Mr. Aro's head behind his left eye
I found at the trial that Mr. Omar was the aggressor in both attacks on Mr. Aro and that they were deliberate
rationale_highlights: Justice Saunders accepted that Mr. Omar may have suffered from impacts of inter-generational trauma from events that drove his parents to come to Canada as refugees
It has almost certainly been a contributing factor to Mr. Omar's marihuana use, which, as the psychiatric assessment shows, has profoundly affected his mental health
Thus, while the picture is not clear, I accept this factor provides at least some measure of explanation for Mr. Omar's behaviour
note: Court finds only some explanation; never states reduced culpability or sentence effect.
